step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a differential preamplifier with diode-connected PMOS loads (XM1, XM10, XM6, XM8), followed by a clocked reset/latch stage (XM7, XM9, XM2, XM5). Extracted from a Flash ADC, it serves as the front-end for a comparator to amplify the input difference, reduce kickback noise, and provide a reset mechanism between conversions.

paper_reference.title: A 6-bit 1.2-GS/s Low-Power Flash-ADC in 0.13-m Digital CMOS

dc_gain.description: Differential DC gain of the preamplifier stage (N1-N6).

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain is roughly gm_n / gm_p. With W/L=5/0.5 for both, gm_n/gm_p = sqrt(un/up) = sqrt(270/50) = 2.32 V/V. 20*log10(2.32) = 7.3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the square-law transconductance ratio of the NMOS input pair to the PMOS diode-connected loads.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the PMOS load resistance (1/gm_p) and parasitic capacitance at N1/N6.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The low impedance of the diode-connected loads pushes the dominant pole to high frequencies, easily exceeding 1 GHz in 130nm.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_tail ≈ 1.05 mA (Vov=0.28V). Two stages ≈ 2.1 mA. Power = 1.8V * 2.1mA = 3.78 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated from the bias voltage (0.7V) and tail transistor dimensions. A 6-bit flash has 63 comparators, so ~3.8mW per slice aligns with the 160mW total.

input_capacitance.description: Input capacitance at the INP node.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the gate area of the input NMOS transistor XM10. 25fF per comparator * 63 comparators ≈ 1.5pF total, which is higher than the paper's 400fF due to the large 5um/0.5um sizing in this specific netlist.

step3_testbench.description: Measures preamplifier differential gain, bandwidth, power consumption, input capacitance, and verifies the reset switch functionality.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Flash ADC Preamplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N1 INN N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 OUTP CLK GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 BIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 OUTP OUTP GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 OUTP CLK GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N6 N6 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 OUTP N6 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N1 N1 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 OUTP N1 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N6 INP N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 OUTP OUTN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}

* Fix floating nodes from extraction
V_N5 N5 VDD 0
V_N2 N2 VDD 0
V_OUTN OUTN 0 0

* Power and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VBIAS BIAS 0 0.7
VCLK CLK 0 DC 0 PULSE(0 1.8 5n 0.1n 0.1n 5n 10n)

* Inputs
VINP INP 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5
VINN INN 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. AC Analysis for Gain, Bandwidth, and Input Capacitance
  ac dec 100 1Meg 100G
  let vdiff = v(N1) - v(N6)
  let gain_mag = mag(vdiff)
  let gain_db = 20 * log10(gain_mag)
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db='dc_gain - 3' fall=1
  
  let i_in_mag = mag(i(VINP))
  meas ac i_in_1g find i_in_mag at=1G
  let cin = i_in_1g / (2 * 3.14159 * 1e9 * 0.5)
  print cin

  * 3. Transient Analysis for Reset Behavior
  tran 0.1n 20n
  meas tran outp_max max v(OUTP)
  meas tran outp_min min v(OUTP)
  
  quit
.endc
.end
